title: Automate changelog and onboard lyra-11b v1.0 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Maya Chen
description:
Onboard lyra-11b v1.0 to the model registry and add automated changelog/release-notes wiring. Motivation: lyra-11b is a lower-cost, high-quality 11B model requested by several customers; onboarding includes performance profiles for primary serving configurations and hooks to automatically publish changelog entries when perf/metadata are updated.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds model metadata and package files under redwood-model-registry/models/lyra-11b/v1.0 including license, sample prompts, and model schema.
- Adds performance profiles for common infra shapes (g4dn, a100-40gb, a100-80gb) with throughput/latency baselines and token cost estimates.
- Implements a lightweight changelog automation script (scripts/automate_changelog.py) that: validates model metadata, computes a standardized release note entry, and appends it to docs/changelogs/models.md by commit-author; integrates with the existing model-registry CI job.
- Updates CI workflows to run model metadata linting + perf profile validation and to surface changelog artifact in build artifacts.
- Adds unit tests for metadata schema and a smoke perf-check that verifies profile keys exist and expected numeric ranges are present.

Why automated changelog: previously changelog updates were manual and occasionally missed when perf profiles changed; automation reduces human error and keeps release notes in sync with model catalog changes.

Testing performed:
- Local schema validation and unit tests (tests/model_registry/test_lyra_onboard.py) cover metadata parsing and changelog string generation.
- CI run: initial run failed due to strict float formatting in perf profile; fixed formatting and re-ran CI. Final CI status: all checks passed.

How to review:
- Focus on metadata fields in metadata.yaml (required keys: id, version, license, vocab_size, context_size, tokenizer, quantization_recommendation).
- Perf profiles are lightweight JSONs; ensure latency and throughput baselines are reasonable and units are documented.
- scripts/automate_changelog.py is intentionally small and well-commented; check edge cases (existing entry deduplication, timezone handling).

Related tickets: ENG-2187 (model onboarding), ENG-1293 (changelog automation), SUP-4421 (customer request for lyra).

release_notes: Onboarded lyra-11b v1.0: an efficient 11B model providing strong quality/cost tradeoffs.
Added performance profiles for g4dn, a100-40gb, and a100-80gb serving targets with latency/throughput baselines.
Introduced automation to generate and append model registry changelog entries when metadata or perf profiles change (scripts/automate_changelog.py).
notes_for_ops: When deploying lyra-11b, prefer the a100-80gb profile for low-latency single-request workloads. Use quantization profile Q4 for batch workloads to improve throughput. If customers need private deployment, ensure model license field is visible to legal (metadata.yaml).
